snippet.title: The Sky Project: Land of Noris | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
☁️ The Sky Project: Land of Noris | Official Teaser ☁️

➡️ Follow our Kickstarter and get notified when the campaign launches!
👉 https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/entharielgames/the-sky-project-land-of-noris

A nuzlocke-inspired monster collector RPG where every battle matters… and every Noris lost is gone forever.

Descend through four mythic planes connected by streams of mana. Form magical bonds with unique creatures, watch them evolve and awaken new powers, and make choices that will shape their fate and the world itself.

Beautiful 2D exploration, emotional storytelling, and permanent consequences.

Are you ready to become a true Noris Keeper?

#TheSkyProject #LandOfNoris #MonsterCollector #NuzlockeRPG #IndieRPG #KickstarterGame
